item.description: Chandigarh: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has acquitted Dera Sacha Sauda chief Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh in the 2002 murder case of a journalist, sect head’s lawyer Jitender Khurana said Saturday. item.title: Iran’s UN envoy says 1,332 civilians killed in US-Israeli airstrikes
item.description: United Nations: At least 1,332 Iranian civilians, including women and children, have been killed in US-Israeli airstrikes and thousands more injured, Iran’s UN ambassador Amir Saeid Iravani said. item.title: 3.5-magnitude tremor recorded in Rajasthan
